name: pipeline_softmode_minimum
purpose: TASKS 225, the end-to-end rehearsal: the pipeline all the way to a certificate on a molecule with a soft mode that is a genuine minimum, so the run is not stopped before the spectrum as furan+vinyl's was (its optimised geometry has an imaginary mode, in the corpus as well, and the pipeline rightly refused). pyridine+OH+CF3 (B_0f06474656, 15 atoms, SMILES Oc1cncc(C(F)(F)F)c1) is the molecule the repair itself was validated on this morning - 15.82 / 58.02 cm-1 against the full finite difference's 15.69 / 57.98 - so its repaired numbers are known independently of this run. Every step is computed (--no-reuse). What it has to show: step 3 repairs the soft mode on pyscf 2.15.0, the certificate is written, and the whole run's wall time against the demo's half hour (decision 64)

estimate.basis: furan+vinyl (13 atoms) spent about 20 minutes in step 3 on pyscf 2.15.0, where the CPHF falls back to a per-root solve; this molecule has 15 atoms and three fluorines, and the repair adds two displaced grid-response gradients per soft direction (83 s for one on furan+vinyl)

memory.basis: as pipeline_benzene_computed: the WSL step runs under probes/wsl_capped.sh at 6144 MB; psi4 is given 4 GB and runs before it, not beside it
